newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Sept tax income down 0.2 pct vs year ago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Sept tax income down 0.2 pct vs year ago.

text.p: Argentina's Economy Ministry said Tuesday that tax revenue in September was $3.30 billion, a 0.2 percent drop from the $3.31 billion collected in September 1995.
Including contributions from the private pension funds, total fiscal revenue was $3.54 billion, a 1.2 percent increase over the same month last year.
Revenues from value-added tax were $1.45 billion, up 1.3 percent from September 1995. Income tax revenue was $484 million, 9.3 percent more than in the same month last year.
